title: Kintsugi Sanctuary Over Mirror Water
summary: An interactive Three.js sanctuary where a fractured celadon moon jar orbits above mirror water as molten gold seams reunite its shards.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 artwork and 30-second film. A crane-painted celadon moon jar opens into forty orbiting shards above a Japanese courtyard mirror basin while molten gold beads gather along the broken edges, drip into gilded ripples, and pull the shards back into lacquer seams.
